decisions.reason: A rye country bread is a core everyday staple for a traditional German bakery, cheap to keep in the range and likely to sell steadily.
This flagship stollen won the gold medal again from the Deutsches Brotinstitut, making it a key seasonal revenue and reputation driver.
A seeded rye mixed bread fits established demand and shares production with the existing rye range, so it costs little to keep.
Dark malt rye bread is a niche but traditional variety with low incremental cost, though it is slightly more at risk of range pruning.
Marzipan stollen is a classic seasonal and gift item that complements the flagship stollen line.
The newest ancient grain 'Meisterstück' taps the health and heritage-grain trend and is actively promoted, so it is likely kept.
